aspects.says: Configuration keyed by an enum is loaded into an EnumMap and checked against EnumSet.allOf before it is used, so a constant without a value stops the startup instead of the first request, and an unknown key is reported by name.
basis: section:Enum-Keyed Configuration Belongs in an EnumMap Checked for Every Key at Startup

aspects.says: EnumSet.copyOf(Collection) throws IllegalArgumentException on an empty collection that isn't an EnumSet; noneOf plus addAll handles the empty case.
basis: section:EnumSet Is a Typed Bit Mask, and a Shared One Must Be Unmodifiable
section:Enum-Keyed Configuration Belongs in an EnumMap Checked for Every Key at Startup

aspects.says: The enum state machine checks transitions at run time and keeps values(), EnumMap and a name column; the sealed-record version of unit 2.5.3 refuses wrong transitions at compile time and gives each state its own data.
basis: section:A State Machine Keeps Its Transitions in an EnumMap Filled After the Constants Exist
aspects.reason: a one-clause comparison; unit 2.5.3 owns the sealed-record state machine and practises it

aspects.says: An EnumSet is a bit vector with a type: a set of another enum doesn't compile where permissions are expected, and it prints names, where int flags of two families mix silently.
basis: section:EnumSet Is a Typed Bit Mask, and a Shared One Must Be Unmodifiable
aspects.reason: the difference is a compile error, which a graded run cannot ask the reader to produce; the permission practice builds its flag sets as EnumSets

aspects.says: A constant's constructor arguments can't name a constant declared after it; javac 21 reports an illegal forward reference for the simple name, the qualified name and a lambda.
basis: section:A State Machine Keeps Its Transitions in an EnumMap Filled After the Constants Exist

aspects.says: A stored set of constants is stored as names, not ordinals or a mask built from them, since inserting a constant shifts later ordinals.
basis: section:EnumSet Is a Typed Bit Mask, and a Shared One Must Be Unmodifiable
aspects.reason: one clause pointing to unit 7.2.1, which shows and practises what reordering does to stored ordinals; the permission practice reads a names column

aspects.says: A static final EnumSet is still mutable: a caller that adds to it, or a union built on it in place, changes it for every user; shared sets are wrapped unmodifiable and per-user sets are copies.
basis: section:EnumSet Is a Typed Bit Mask, and a Shared One Must Be Unmodifiable

aspects.says: An enum singleton's fields are shared by every thread, and code that names the constant can't be given another implementation in a test unless it depends on an interface.
basis: section:An Enum With One Constant Is a Singleton That Reflection and Serialization Can't Copy
aspects.reason: a design trade-off: no deterministic test of the reader's code can observe whether callers depend on an interface, and thread-safety of a counter is unit 6.x material

aspects.says: A private constructor doesn't stop setAccessible and newInstance from building a second instance of a class singleton; Constructor.newInstance refuses any enum.
basis: section:An Enum With One Constant Is a Singleton That Reflection and Serialization Can't Copy

aspects.says: An enum constant is serialized as its name and read back as the reader's own constant, so deserialization makes no copy and the constant's fields don't travel.
basis: section:An Enum With One Constant Is a Singleton That Reflection and Serialization Can't Copy

aspects.says: When the values live in code, a switch expression without default makes a new constant a compile error.
basis: section:Enum-Keyed Configuration Belongs in an EnumMap Checked for Every Key at Startup
aspects.reason: one clause pointing to unit 1.2.5, which owns switch exhaustiveness

aspects.says: A state machine keeps its allowed transitions in an EnumMap filled after the constants exist, refuses a move the table doesn't allow and keeps the old state, and gives terminal states an empty row.
basis: section:A State Machine Keeps Its Transitions in an EnumMap Filled After the Constants Exist
